title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for private-installer (helm + terraform integration)
author: Ava Martinez
description: Add automation for tenant RBAC bootstrap used by the private-installer (VPC/on-prem). Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private need a reproducible, least-privilege initial RBAC bundle that the installer and Terraform modules can apply during cluster bootstrap and upgrades. This PR wires Helm chart hooks and Terraform module outputs to generate tenant-scoped ClusterRole/Role/RoleBinding and ServiceAccount objects, adds a reconciliation script for idempotent re-bootstrap, documents upgrade/rollback steps, and includes tests. Changes include: 1) terraform/modules/rbac: new module that emits Helm values and an optional apply=false mode for dry-run; 2) charts/private-installer/templates/rbac-tenant.yaml: templated tenant-scoped roles and bindings with explicit verbs and resource lists; 3) scripts/bootstrap-tenant-rbac.sh: CLI used by installer to apply and verify bootstrap; 4) tooling/upgrade/rollback.md: procedures to handle RBAC drift during upgrades; 5) e2e tests and local CI job that validates least-privilege rules. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implemented and documented - [x] Helm templates added with full unit tests and helm lint passing - [x] Integration test that simulates multi-tenant namespace creation and RBAC isolation - [x] Upgrade/rollback doc and smoke test - [x] Security review from SEC team (SEC-103) Notes: This description is a single continuous string; see review_comments and commits_summary for detail.
commits_summary: 5 commits: (1) add terraform rbac module and examples; (2) helm: tenant rbac templates and values schema; (3) add bootstrap script used by private-installer; (4) tests: unit + integration e2e; (5) docs: upgrade/rollback and release notes
review_comments: Jordan Lee: Please scope ClusterRole rules to the minimal verbs needed; avoid wildcard access to secrets. Suggested splitting cluster-level objects vs namespace-level bindings.
Ava Martinez: Updated templates to use explicit verbs and limited resources; added unit tests for rules and example outputs.
Priya Singh: Add terraform apply=false mode and a validation step so installer can preview changes before applying. Also include a migration path for existing tenants.
Ava Martinez: Added outputs and apply flag; documented migration and added smoke test that runs in CI with a mock cluster.
Ethan Zhao: CI integration flaky on first run (terraform validate timed out). Recommended adding retry and increasing timeout. Approved after re-run and fixes.
Priya Singh: Security review complete. Minor suggestion to log decisions in audit events. Implemented in scripts/bootstrap-tenant-rbac.sh.
release_notes: Add automation to bootstrap tenant-scoped RBAC during Private installer runs. Includes Terraform module, Helm chart templates, a bootstrap CLI script, and upgrade/rollback guidance. No breaking changes. Customers using customized RBAC templates should follow migration steps in docs/upgrade/rollback-rbac.md.
testing_notes: Local CI added: ci/jobs/helm-terraform-validate.yml runs helm lint and terraform validate. E2E uses KinD with multi-namespace isolation; tests/e2e/tenant-rbac.test.ts covers creation, binding, and access checks.
